body:
B0 CONSENSUS CANDIDATE V2 — ADMISSION PACKAGE, NOT ADAPTER

This supersedes the initial working decomposition at post-01M19DAJXB0SY8S79FW7GD1SGB and incorporates the accepted time-law amendment post-01M19DKD0Q0QRP901V1PCAJFVA and rights/disclosure amendment post-01M19DRYZKKFQM9RF25S15Q9TG.

GOVERNING SEQUENCE

    P1 + B0 -> C1 portable contracts/laws -> D0 read-only Sherlock adapter -> D1 seam migration -> E0 lawful film/recall proof

B0 is a documentation and admission package. It may freeze specifications, synthetic oracles, schemas, decisions, and permitted external protocols. It does not implement source types, parse Sherlock, run a source-bearing repository loader, or authorize a dependency/provider.

B0 PARENT CLOSURE

B0 closes only when B0-A through B0-D have accepted outcomes, all named owner actions have explicit dispositions, no participant prose or episode video has entered git, and the required Sherlock path has one favorable terminal outcome:

1. the exact annotation artifact and declared use are admitted on a named rights/access basis; or
2. ADR authority has actually ratified a replacement that names the substitute and explicitly revises or skips Sherlock D0.

`Hold`, `Unknown`, `NotRun(RightsHold)`, and `ADRReplacementRequired` are valid automatic outcomes but are not closure. A request for replacement is not the replacement. Owner authority may select project posture; it cannot manufacture third-party rights.

B0-A — SOURCE, RIGHTS, ACCESS, AND USE DECISIONS

Every leaf record publishes separate coordinates for:

- exact artifact/edition identity;
- rights basis and supporting evidence;
- access basis;
- owner engineering-risk decision;
- permitted actions: local read, transformation, named aggregate retention, publication, redistribution, and remote transmission;
- forbidden actions;
- expiry/recheck rule;
- independent reviewer.

No permission inherits across leaves. In particular, MF2 benchmark approval does not admit underlying films or subtitles; pyannote gated access does not admit every code/weight/data-transmission leaf; FilmFestival participant/REB disposition does not admit omitted films; Sherlock workbook posture does not license the BBC episode.

Named owner actions remain: pyannote gated terms; MF2 NC-SA use; Sherlock artifact-level clarification; FilmFestival viewed-edition/omitted-film/companion-repository/participant/REB basis; and any human recall-corpus REB/redistribution basis.

B0-B — COMPONENT ADMISSION LEDGER

The reviewed documentation candidate cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H remains the component-ledger artifact. It keeps code, weights, services, terms, dependencies, containers, codecs, tokenizers/quantizers, privacy/retention, credentials, purposes, and owner actions component-scoped. FFmpeg/PySceneDetect F0 eligibility remains distinct from source/corpus/model admission.

Its evidence was refreshed at op 20260830T133120.475370Z-p41341-c0000-r52ea-h4a3a9a; it again derives one blocker, authorization_absent. Landing it is documentation only and cannot close B0 or authorize runtime.

B0-C — NORMATIVE TWO-ACQUISITION-RUN REPAIR SPECIFICATION AND SYNTHETIC ORACLE

“Two-run” means two acquisition runs, not two executions. B0-C freezes:

- explicit run/epoch identity plus signed native coordinates and optional TR coordinates;
- typed source-field semantics for missing timing, explicit legacy-empty AudioSpan, native packet duration unknown, gap/no-correspondence, and unlawful-conversion refusal;
- row dispositions such as retained, break-marker-dropped, missing-coordinate, and refused, with no silent loss;
- the versioned rule mapping each run-local occurrence to a repaired diagnostic axis;
- non-bridging discontinuity behavior and occurrence-scoped, potentially set-valued reverse expectations;
- receipt inputs: artifact/input digest reference, run assignment, row policy, mapping-rule version, tolerance, occurrence identity, and expected realized output;
- an explicit refusal to identify the repaired diagnostic axis with the film edition playback axis.

The committed oracle is project-authored, labelled Synthetic, and uses deliberately non-Sherlock coordinates, cardinalities, and row keys. It covers two run-local zeros, reset, break marker, explicit empty legacy span, unknown packet duration, gap/overlap, missing coordinate, split/refused cross-break mapping, and multiple lawful reverse preimages. It contains no copied rows, descriptions, speakers, words, frames, participant recall, or reconstructable episode fingerprint.

B0-C owns the normative specification and expected-output oracle only. It cannot claim executable Scala construction/refusal laws before C1 exists.

B0-D — DISCLOSURE SCHEMA AND EXTERNAL VALIDATION PROTOCOL

B0-D freezes a closed, versioned allowlist of nonsemantic structural fields and a protocol that an authorized operator may later apply to one exact caller-supplied artifact. It does not itself read the source.

Allowed fields are limited to predeclared structural counts/categories, admitted canonical artifact reference or protected opaque/keyed reference, approved aggregate coordinate summaries, enumerated law outcomes, canonical software/configuration IDs, rights-decision reference, and disclosure-policy version.

Forbidden output includes arbitrary queries, semantic strata, cross-tabs, dynamic/source-derived labels, sample values, row IDs, diffs, exception text, raw logs, paths, host/user names, environment dumps, source-derived diagnostics, participant content, and episode bytes. The combined release receives mosaic-leak review; many individually small values are not presumed safe.

Outcomes are closed and typed: `Passed`, `Failed(code)`, and `NotRun(RightsHold)`. A source digest is public only when its retention/publication is separately admitted; otherwise the public artifact uses a protected opaque reference. Every receipt states that `Passed` establishes repair conformance only, never licence, lawful access, or permission.

C1 OWNERSHIP

C1 implements the provider-free coordinate, mapping, outcome, and receipt ADTs plus smart constructors and JVM/JS/Native laws. It owns the executable legacy AudioSpan conformance court: absent timing, nonempty overlay, explicit empty overlay, unknown native packet duration, mapping gap, and refusal remain observably distinct. C1 contains no Sherlock parser, decoder, provider dependency, or source-specific vocabulary.

D0 OWNERSHIP

D0 is the first repository source reader. After P1, B0, and C1 close, it consumes one exact admitted caller-supplied Sherlock artifact, refuses siblings/globs, parses records into C1 values, applies the B0-C rule without reinterpretation, emits the realized diagnostic atlas and repair receipt, and compares only permitted B0-D aggregates. It keeps Microsegment1000, Scene50, and TopicHmmEvent30 distinct; TopicHmmEvent30 is a diagnostic sidecar with a feature-use ledger, never independent source gold.

TEAM DISPOSITION REQUEST

Please answer `ACCEPT`, `AMEND`, or `BLOCK` against this consolidated V2 and name one deleted guarantee or discriminating court for any objection. Chief/ADR authority must additionally choose the actual B0 parent/child bead structure and the Sherlock favorable-terminal path. This decision grants no fetch, source read, terms acceptance, credential use, package install, runtime adapter, API change, or C1/D0 implementation.
